name: Movie & TV posters (TMDB)
description: Shows the poster from The Movie Database on package cards. The package name must contain tmdbid=<id>, e.g. "Some Movie (2021) [tmdbid=12345]". Movie or series is worked out from the title, the year and hints like S01E02.

settings.label: TMDB API key
settings.description: The API key (v3) or the API read access token from themoviedb.org → Settings → API.

settings.label: Language
settings.description: Language of titles and posters, e.g. de-DE.
